To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) integrated capture is an effective approach for capturing everyday life memories of young children; (2) parents' desire for capturing memories can conflict with their desire to be with their children; (3) the KidKeeper system design can be used to mediate these conflicting interests.
(a) KidKeeper can help parents capture and share family memories of everyday life, and (b) parents and children can work together in a playful manner to capture and share these family memories.

(1) integrated capture can be used to capture everyday life without disruption, (2) the use of integrated capture can be aligned with family values to capture moments that are meaningful for the family, and (3) the alignment of interests can lead to the creation of new family memories.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how to capture and deliver memories of everyday life in a way that is aligned with parents' values, and that does not disrupt family life.
the following question: How do we design for the capture of everyday memories of children's lives for parents, and what are the implications for the design of such technologies?
how to design technologies that can support the capture of family memories of everyday life, while respecting the values and priorities of all family members.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
KidKeeper is a toy that captures everyday life of young children and delivers it to parents.
KidKeeper, as a system that mediates the different interests and goals of various family members towards a shared goal, is able to capture everyday family memories with little effort and disruption.
KidKeeper provides an integrated capture approach that enables the capture of family memories with minimal disruption to everyday life.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
KidKeeper is an integrated capture system for everyday family memories that is designed to align the interests and values of family members, especially parents of young children.
the design of KidKeeper is a reflection of the family values, and the design process is a process of negotiation among family members to achieve the family goals.
KidKeeper provides a design space that allows us to explore and address a number of challenges in the design of technologies for family memories.
The main takeaway from our work is that
technologies like KidKeeper can be used to mediate between different interests and values in a family to accomplish a family goal, in this case, capturing everyday family moments.
the design of technologies to support family life should consider the different interests of family members, and the ways in which these different interests can align and be mediated by technology.

a system to support the capture of family memories needs to be designed to accommodate the different interests and activities of the various family members, while at the same time align them to the family goal.
